label: late copy steps of very short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Copy-phase-only update-gate unit that tracks short sequence length. It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter. For L=3 it fires on almost every copy step (precision about 0.85). It is strongest at the final output (t=5, recall_idx 2, where the input is orig(1)), weaker at recall_idx 1 (about 0.1-0.5 of max), and silent at recall_idx 0. L=3 holds about 60% of activation mass. For L=4 it fires mainly at recall_idx 2 (second-to-last output), and only for some input tokens (p, u, x, g, digits and others have higher rates), so it is partly token-dependent. Longer sequences (L>=5) give sparse, weak activations at scattered copy positions, about 15% of mass, which the predicate misses. The L=4 token list is fitted to the data and only approximate.
